capabilities: Add text objects for quotes, brackets, tags, separators, subwords, indentation and key/value pairs
Add, delete and replace surroundings with sandwich-style operations
Replace text with Vim register contents using gr motions
Select and yank whole Markdown pipe tables in source or live preview
Configure object groups and remap identifiers in the settings tab
disambiguation: Not a general Vim configuration tool; it adds text objects, surround and register-replace operations on top of the built-in Vim mode.
extras: Requires built-in Vim key bindings enabled and desktop Obsidian 1.14.5+; uses Obsidian's undocumented Vim adapter, so Obsidian updates may require a plugin update. Includes a compatibility-check command that creates a temporary note and writes validation.json. Runs locally with no network access.
intentEvidence: Extend Obsidian's built-in Vim mode with automatic quote/surrounding text objects, sandwich-style editing, and register replacement.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Vim mode lacks surround editing, rich text objects, and register-based replacement that Vim plugin users rely on.
